  • Managing schedule, risks, issues and reporting for your delivery streams

  • Proven hands-on project delivery experience in technical, IT or application rollouts
  • Comfortable coordinating hardware and software installation, testing and go-live activities

  • Primarily Wellington-based to be close to the customer

  • Some sites are delivered in phases over roughly three months.

An early start is preferred, ideally in November or before Christmas, to allow a full handover period.

job.title: Ways of Working Coach
job.description:
One of the larger businesses in New Zealand, its people are proud of their longevity and the quality services they provide. With a national presence, an impressive Leadership team, a culture shaped by organisational values, it is a dynamic and complex business, and it this combination which attracts great talent keen to do interesting work. 

To ensure its ongoing success, the executive leadership team is committed to a new operating model, and the programme has strong senior sponsorship.

This newly created role, Ways of Working Coach, will work alongside senior leaders to help them understand, adopt and embed new ways of working across their areas. 

The Opportunity:
  • Coaching and partnering with executive and senior leaders.
  • Helping leaders translate the operating model into practical ways of working.
  • Influencing leadership behaviours, decision-making, accountability and collaboration.
  • Supporting leaders and their teams through significant organisational change.
  • Bringing together Agile, portfolio management and broader transformation approaches in a pragmatic way.
  • Navigating different levels of maturity and helping leaders adapt their approach accordingly.
  • Building capability so that new ways of working become embedded rather than dependent on a coach.
The environment is complex and dynamic. Some areas already operate in contemporary ways, while others are more traditional, so success will require pragmatism rather than a rigid adherence to any particular framework or methodology.

About you:
You may currently be working as a Ways of Working Coach, Agile Coach, Organisational Transformation Consultant or in a general consulting role where you have helped organisations change how they operate, having a good blend of understanding various frameworks and business acumen.

Agile certification is not essential. More important is your ability to combine an understanding of ways of working with strong commercial and organisational acumen.

In summary, you will bring:
  • Strong experience in ways of working, Agile, consulting and/or organisational transformation.
  • Excellent business acumen and the ability to understand the broader organisational context.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging, coaching and influencing executive and senior stakeholders.
  • The credibility and confidence to challenge constructively and operate as a trusted partner.
  • An adaptable and pragmatic approach – able to use different methodologies without being constrained by them.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and relationship-building skills.
  • The ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgement and take ownership for outcomes.
You will be comfortable working in an environment where leaders have different styles, levels of experience and readiness for change. You will know when to coach, when to challenge and when to adapt your approach to bring people with you.

Intrigued? 
You will also join a small, high-trust team where you will be given autonomy to deliver. The leadership style is supportive and empowering, with an expectation that experienced people will manage themselves, bring ideas and take ownership.
We are open to different levels of experience and interested in people who can bring something distinctive to the team.
Permanent is preferred, although a 12-month fixed-term arrangement may also be considered for the right person.
If you are excited by the opportunity to move beyond team-level coaching and influence how senior leaders and an organisation work, Apply Now OR call Sharon Ward Duncan 021 356 777 for a confidential conversation and more information.

job.title: Machine Learning Lead
job.description:
We're recruiting a Machine Learning Lead for our client in the professional services space. You'll build the models yourself, and you'll also decide how every model gets tested, released, and kept honest once it's live.

You'll be the technical authority on model lifecycle management, working alongside Data Science, Technology, Risk and the wider business. There are no direct reports, so your influence comes from your expertise and the standards you set.

The Role
  • Design, build and validate advanced machine learning and generative AI models, leading the most complex, business-critical work
  • Define and own the end-to-end MLOps framework, from development and versioning through to release, monitoring and retirement
  • Build and maintain automated ML pipelines (CI/CD and continuous training) across Azure, Databricks and Snowflake
  • Own the model registry and inventory, so every production model has clear ownership, lineage and approval status
  • Lead release management, including shadow, canary and champion/challenger deployments, with rollback plans
  • Set up monitoring for drift, performance, fairness, latency and cost, and drive retraining when needed
  • Extend MLOps to generative AI, including prompt versioning, evaluation harnesses and guardrails
  • Work with Risk, Compliance and Architecture on model risk and responsible AI controls
  • Mentor others, set coding and modelling standards, and explain complex topics to senior stakeholders in plain English

What You'll Bring
Must haves
  • 6+ years in data science or machine learning engineering, including 2+ years leading MLOps or ML platform work
  • Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to review human and AI-generated code
  • Deep knowledge of ML methods (GLMs, GAMs, gradient boosting, time series, deep learning) and generative AI
  • Hands-on MLOps tooling: MLflow or similar, Azure Machine Learning or Azure AI Foundry, and Databricks
  • Solid DevOps skills: CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), Docker and infrastructure as code
  • A track record of running production ML pipelines at enterprise scale, with measurable business results
  • Strong influencing skills and the ability to set standards without formal authority
Nice to have
  • Insurance, financial services or other regulated industry experience
  • Experience with model risk, audit or compliance teams
  • A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering or Mathematics (or equivalent experience)

Why This Role
  • Real ownership. You'll shape how the models behind pricing, customer and operational decisions are built and run
  • A senior technical seat without people management
  • Hybrid working, with three days a week in a central Auckland CBD office
  • A modern stack and scope to evaluate and recommend new tools and practices
  • A genuinely diverse and inclusive workplace

How to Apply
Keen to hear more? Send your CV through Seek, or get in touch with Lesha Grey (leshagrey@momentum.co.nz) for a confidential chat.

To be considered for this role, you must hold New Zealand working rights. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship.
